construction: 63 parts in 11 steps. Step 3: twelve Technic bricks 1×2 with hole, stacked on their sides with studs forward. Steps 6 and 8: side skins of plates and tiles. Step 9: the forward skin of 2×4 tiles and plates. Steps 10–11: slopes and a 4×4 triple-curved wedge form the nose.
interfaces: Stud directions: 63 parts, 0 up, 47 −Z (forward), 8 +X, 8 −X. The parent tilts the whole section about 23° about X.
lesson: A smooth vehicle panel is a studs-forward column skinned with tiles, then tilted as a whole.
parent_context: The front leg shield of the Vespa (`10298 - vespa.ldr`).
reuse_notes: This is the technique the Technic car trial lacked: point the panel's studs at the surface, skin them with tiles, and tilt the section once.
